payload.task_label: GitHub issues 180-183 implementation and child-family closeout
payload.expected: Implement children 181 through 183, verify the complete acceptance family, and close them before parent 180.
payload.observed: The correct outcome was reached after repeated closeout-body revisions across the TDD, review, and implement validators and a split shared core plus four acceptance-audit chunks.
payload.consequence: The closeout required substantial additional validation and tracker-publication cycles before all four issues could be closed.
payload.workaround_taken: Used the prescribed split-core workflow, exact-read every posted comment, and revised the staged evidence bodies until every applicable validator passed.

payload.expected: The implementation workflow would produce a directly usable standalone-issue closeout body that passed its prescribed validators.
payload.observed: The run completed correctly, but the generated body described a sibling issue set for standalone issue #184 and required repeated manual evidence-field corrections across TDD, normal-review, and implement validation passes.
payload.consequence: Closeout required additional drafting, inspection, and validator reruns before the verified tracker comment could be posted.
payload.workaround_taken: Manually reconciled the generated closeout body with validator requirements, reran all applicable validators, then exact-read the posted GitHub comment before closing the issue.

payload.expected: Complete implementation, verification, review, and ordered tracker closeout with one validated parent rollup.
payload.observed: Implementation and closeout succeeded, but the closeout body required factual wording and concrete-path repairs after the first TDD, review, and implement validator pass.
payload.consequence: Additional evidence-body editing and validator reruns were required before posting the rollup and closing the issues.
payload.workaround_taken: Patched only the closeout record, reran all three closing validators, then ran the mutation-ready preflight before tracker changes.

payload.summary: Candidate improved standalone routing but regressed explicit no-parent language in the sibling trial; high-risk noninferiority gate failed.

payload.note: Target-owned first-pass closeout routing defect confirmed. The isolated candidate improved standalone routing and validator-sensitive wording, but blind trial 3 omitted the explicit no-parent statement for a sibling issue set, so the high-risk noninferiority gate rejected it and the live target remained unchanged.

payload.expected: Apply the fixed evaluation's critical-failure stop rule and complete #176 and #171 with verified evidence.
payload.observed: An earlier authorized replay continued with requests 2 and 3 before a stricter rubric reread established that scenario 1 should have stopped that ceiling; the deviation was preserved in the evidence.
payload.consequence: Two provider requests were consumed after the missed stop, and completion required further offline repair, verification, and separately authorized replay cycles.
payload.workaround_taken: Recorded the deviation, tightened the rubric and prompt contract test-first, reran verification, and used only fresh explicitly authorized ceilings for later replays.

payload.task_label: Implement and close GitHub #190 and parent #187
payload.expected: Complete the implementation and tracker closeout with a single composed evidence body and validation pass.
payload.observed: Implementation and issue closure succeeded, but the closeout evidence required multiple validator-driven rewrites and repeated gate interpretation before mutation.
payload.consequence: The session used substantial additional time and context before tracker closeout; no incorrect external state resulted.
payload.workaround_taken: Iteratively corrected the TDD, review, and closeout evidence until every required validator passed, then exact-read both issue closures.

payload.expected: Complete the authorized single-issue implementation, review, and tracker closeout through a concise validated evidence path.
payload.observed: The implementation, verification, browser proof, review, and closeout succeeded, but the evidence body required repeated field corrections and validator reruns before mutation readiness.
payload.consequence: The correct task outcome required substantial additional evidence-composition time and context before the tracker mutation could proceed.
payload.workaround_taken: Used the generated scaffold, corrected validator-reported fields and the stale ADR evidence label, then reran every applicable validator before posting.

payload.expected: The prescribed manifest, audit, and closeout tools accept the exact issue criterion and produce one validator-ready closeout body.
payload.observed: The generated audit preserved the issue's literal angle-bracket effort text, and the closeout validator rejected that literal as an unresolved placeholder; the run needed a table-rendering workaround plus repeated build, validation, review, and commit-amend cycles.
payload.consequence: The implementation completed correctly, but tracker closeout was delayed and the final local commit and evidence packet had to be refreshed multiple times before publication.
payload.workaround_taken: The run added entity-safe Markdown table rendering through one shared encoder, added regression coverage for manifest, audit, and structured-closeout paths, reran final gates and both review axes, and then completed closeout.
